import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = {
    "Source6_19_0": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/training_0.csv",
    "Source6_19_1": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/training_1.csv",
    "Source6_19_2": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/training_2.csv",
    "Source6_19_3": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/training_3.csv",
    "Source6_19_4": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/training_4.csv",
    "Source6_19_5": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/training_5.csv",
    "Source6_19_6": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/training_6.csv",
    "Source6_19_7": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/training_7.csv",
}

# Step 1: Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source6_19_0"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Score']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source6_19_1"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Albums in RS500']
df2 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source6_19_2"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Top 100 Singles', 'Highest Position']
df3 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source6_19_3"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Times on Cover of RS']
df4 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source6_19_4"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Influenced']
df5 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source6_19_5"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Certified Units (Millions)']
df6 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source6_19_6"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Spotify']
df7 = pd.read_csv(source_files["Source6_19_7"], index_col=0)  # ['Artist', 'Year Inducted', 'Years Waited', '# of Years Nominated']

# Step 2: Merge all dataframes on 'Artist' using left joins starting from df7 (which has multiple columns)
# This is because df7 has the most columns related to Year Inducted, Years Waited, and # of Years Nominated,
# which are important and appear only in this source.

# Merge order chosen to keep all artists from df7 and add other attributes where available.
df = df7.copy()

# Merge with df0 (Score)
df = df.merge(df0, on='Artist', how='left')

# Merge with df1 (Albums in RS500)
df = df.merge(df1, on='Artist', how='left')

# Merge with df2 (Top 100 Singles, Highest Position)
df = df.merge(df2, on='Artist', how='left')

# Merge with df3 (Times on Cover of RS)
df = df.merge(df3, on='Artist', how='left')

# Merge with df4 (Influenced)
df = df.merge(df4, on='Artist', how='left')

# Merge with df5 (Certified Units (Millions))
df = df.merge(df5, on='Artist', how='left')

# Merge with df6 (Spotify)
df = df.merge(df6, on='Artist', how='left')

# Step 3: Ensure all target columns exist in the final dataframe, fill missing columns with NaN or appropriate types
target_columns = [
    'Artist',
    'Year Inducted',
    'Years Waited',
    '# of Years Nominated',
    'Influenced',
    'Certified Units (Millions)',
    'Albums in RS500',
    'Top 100 Singles',
    'Highest Position',
    'Times on Cover of RS',
    'Score',
    'Spotify'
]

# Some columns might be missing if no data was found; add them with NaN if needed
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df.columns:
        df[col] = pd.NA

# Step 4: Cast columns to target types as specified
# Target Schema:
# 'Artist': string
# 'Year Inducted': float
# 'Years Waited': integer
# '# of Years Nominated': integer
# 'Influenced': integer
# 'Certified Units (Millions)': float
# 'Albums in RS500': integer
# 'Top 100 Singles': integer
# 'Highest Position': integer
# 'Times on Cover of RS': integer
# 'Score': float
# 'Spotify': integer

# Convert 'Artist' to string
df['Artist'] = df['Artist'].astype(str)

# Helper function to convert columns safely
def to_float(series):
    return pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce').astype('float64')

def to_int(series):
    # Convert to float first to handle NaNs, then to Int64 (nullable integer dtype)
    return pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Apply conversions
df['Year Inducted'] = to_float(df['Year Inducted'])
df['Years Waited'] = to_int(df['Years Waited'])
df['# of Years Nominated'] = to_int(df['# of Years Nominated'])
df['Influenced'] = to_int(df['Influenced'])
df['Certified Units (Millions)'] = to_float(df['Certified Units (Millions)'])
df['Albums in RS500'] = to_int(df['Albums in RS500'])
df['Top 100 Singles'] = to_int(df['Top 100 Singles'])
df['Highest Position'] = to_int(df['Highest Position'])
df['Times on Cover of RS'] = to_int(df['Times on Cover of RS'])
df['Score'] = to_float(df['Score'])
df['Spotify'] = to_int(df['Spotify'])

# Step 5: Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df = df[target_columns]

# Step 6: Write the result to the specified output path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_19/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
